game_concept: A speed quiz set in Snowy Hold – Frozen Well, a frozen village well: the hold guard must handle yeti raiders while practicing functions. Core idea – Helper Factory: Refactor repeated code into helper functions to save time during a rush.
theme: Snowy Hold – Frozen Well: a frozen village well
core_gameplay_loop: In Frozen Well, repeat each round: Refactor repeated code into helper functions to save time during a rush. Each round, a new firewood challenge appears; solve it to bank points before time drains. Then check the refactor_score value and advance.
player_objective: Collect 390 points of firewood by answering each challenge with the right code concept before the clock runs out.
controls: Touch: tap tiles or buttons to choose values, swipe to move, long-press for a hint.
lose_condition: Timer hits 0 with score < 390, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 6 – Functions | Level 6 (applied tier): Helper Factory
assets_style: cozy pixel-art snow town: icy blue rooftops, frosted pines, warm lantern glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; soft bells, wind howls and cozy hearth crackle
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Helper Factory' (Week 6 slot 6), mission type 'Resource Rush', and setting 'Frozen Well'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Snowy Hold
region.mood: soft bells, wind howls and cozy hearth crackle

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how refactor_score changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against yeti raiders in Frozen Well.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: score >= 390 within 36 seconds.
